name: slop-doom
description: DOOM (shareware) in a pane: doomgeneric runs as WebAssembly in a sidecar, every frame lands as native pixels (kitty, Ghostty) or a Raster.

fps.description: Frames a second the sidecar sends to the pane. Lower it if the picture flickers.
fps.title: Frames per second

display.description: image: native 320x200 pixels where the terminal draws them (kitty, Ghostty). cells: half-block characters, any terminal. auto: image on a terminal known to draw pixels, cells when it refuses.
display.title: Display

cell.description: Your terminal cell's width divided by its height. Most coding fonts sit near 0.47; a 1:2 font is 0.5. Raise it if bands show beside the picture, lower it if they show above and below.
cell.title: Cell shape

blocks.description: Glyphs of the cells display. quad shows four pixels a cell in two colours (sharper); half shows two, one above the other, for fonts whose quadrant glyphs leave seams.
blocks.title: Cells glyphs

filter.description: How a cell's colour is picked from its pixels on the cells display. mode keeps edges crisp, box is soft, nearest is noisy.
filter.title: Cells filter
